label: Logo / name grid
description: Social-proof band: a horizontal run of 3-8 name chips. Each chip is a CSS monogram disc (first letter of the label) paired with a wordmark label, panel-styled. Optional eyebrow + title pin top-left; the chip band sits below and packs into one row for up to 4 names, two rows for 5-8. Discs pop in first, then labels fade up.
